summary: The evidence-first prompt is a bounded, general selection improvement with no retrieval/index or safety-semantic changes. It is not benchmark-ID-specific, and the supplied public results improve hard-pass coverage from the repository baseline’s 80.0% (24/30) to 83.3% (25/30), with negative pass remaining 100% and no increase in human-reject count.
next_direction: Treat this as a validated prompt-level selection gain. Next, investigate remaining scored failures by separating candidate-availability/data-evidence problems from reranker selection errors before proposing another prompt rewrite; retain the public failure cases only as class-level diagnostic evidence, never as ID-specific logic.
